column3: Go to admin journal and articles search, find "Success 100" article
In Authors section, set first author's Name to "Author 1", Affiliations to "University of Oxford; Harvard University", and ORCID to "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789"
In the second author subform, set Name to "Author 2", Affiliations to "MIT; Stanford University; Cambridge University", and ORCID to "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3456-7890"

column4: Green banner saying "Article created/updated" is shown at the top of the page.

column3: Close the page and search for "Success 100" article again

column4: First author has Name "Author 1", Affiliations "University of Oxford; Harvard University", and ORCID "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789"
Second author has Name "Author 2", Affiliations "MIT; Stanford University; Cambridge University", and ORCID "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3456-7890"
